Class OllamaAiProvider

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.event.BasicPropertyChangeSource
uno.anahata.asi.agi.provider.AbstractAiProvider
uno.anahata.asi.openai.compatible.OpenAiChatCompletionsProvider
uno.anahata.asi.ollama.OllamaAiProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
public class OllamaAiProvider extends OpenAiChatCompletionsProvider
Dedicated AI Provider for local and self-hosted Ollama servers.

Seamlessly manages Ollama instances by querying native management endpoints (/api/tags, /api/ps, /api/version, /api/show) to extract exact model capabilities, GGUF parameter sizes, quantization formats, and allocated context lengths, while routing chat completions through the standardized OpenAI-compatible pipeline.

Author:
anahata

    • activePulls

      private transient Map<String, Consumer<OllamaPullProgress>> activePulls
      Set of model names currently being pulled in the background. Marked transient so Kryo does not attempt to serialize active thread listeners when persisting provider state.

    • listModels

      public List<? extends AbstractModel> listModels()
      Fetches the list of all models available from the provider's remote API.

      Implementation details: Performs a GET request to the /models endpoint of the configured getBaseUrl(). Parses the standard OpenAI list-response and wraps each ID in an OpenAiCompatibleModel instance.

      Queries native Ollama model tags via GET /api/tags. Falls back gracefully to standard OpenAI /models if the native endpoint is unavailable.

      Overrides:
      listModels in class OpenAiChatCompletionsProvider
      Returns:
      A list of provider-specific AbstractModel objects.

    • testConnection

      public String testConnection() throws Exception
      Tests connectivity to the provider's remote API endpoint and returns a human-readable status summary.

      The default implementation executes AbstractAiProvider.refreshCachedApiModels() and formats a summary of discovered models. Subclasses (like Ollama) can override this to return rich diagnostic details such as server versions and live running models.

      Connects to Ollama, inspects the server version, and summarizes discovered models.

      Overrides:
      testConnection in class AbstractAiProvider
      Returns:
      A descriptive connection confirmation message.
      Throws:
      Exception - if remote connectivity or authentication fails.
